item.title: PDP crisis: Wike-loyal NEC declares party united, fixes National Convention, pushes 2027 comeback
item.description: National Executive Committee (NEC) of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), aligned with the Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, has declared the party united and repositioned for a strong political comeback ahead of the 2027 general elections.

item.title: Atiku visits Malami, blasts Tinubu's Govt over ‘political detentions’, demands El-Rufai’s release (+Photos)
item.description: Former Vice President Atiku Abubakar calls for the immediate release of Nasir El-Rufai and other political detainees, warning against arrests based on political differences.

item.title: NYSC official walks free after corps member dies in suspicious abortion case
item.description: An Abeokuta court has granted bail to Abass Olalekan, popularly known as Ola Kamara, a Local Government Inspector (LGI) with the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) in Abeokuta South, following his arraignment on charges of conspiracy and attempted procurement of abortion.

item.title: Youth, tech, and civic innovation take centre stage as PROMAD hosts roundtable in Abuja
item.description: Abuja is set to host a high-profile gathering of young leaders, civil society actors, media practitioners, and tech innovators as PROMAD, a civic innovation organisation, announces a one-day Hybrid Youth, CSO, and Media Roundtable on Youth, Technology, and Development.

item.title: Nigerian Army chaplain urges troops of OPHK to strengthen faith in discharge of operational engagements
item.description: Acting Director, Chaplain Services (Protestant), Nigerian Army, Colonel (Reverend) Bitrus Nyam, has urged troops of Operation HADIN KAI (OPHK) to strengthen their faith and remain spiritually grounded as they sustain ongoing operations against insurgents in the North East region.
